_comment: Prop & FX prompt cores (plan §10.4). The generator prepends the style block in object mode and appends the negative block. Flat FX sprites (confetti pieces, cursor spark, aura) generate through the sprite mode below — per Zach (29 Aug), these are AI-generated like everything else.
objectMode: single object, centered, pure white seamless background, soft studio lighting from upper left, soft ambient occlusion under the object
